projectDescription: This project aims to automatically detect suspicious activities in Windows Server event logs (Security, System, Application) using machine learning techniques. An Isolation Forest model is trained for each log type, enabling the identification of failed and repeated login attempts, privilege escalations, suspicious account creation, abnormal service execution, and activities occurring outside normal hours. This application allows you to upload a log, evaluate it, and review events flagged as anomalous.
registerPreTrainedModel: Register a pre-trained model for a given log type. The model must already be present server-side with a .joblib extension.
